feature: Every selectable family by six-hazard physical smoke matrix

criteria.evidence: All 18 cells launched a reachable choice, accepted first choice and rendered choiceFeedback. 36 native screenshots exported and reviewed. XCTest method passed without failed assertions.
Distinct hazard decision panels and some household equipment/advisory differences visible, but first-choice feedback alone does not establish all required causal branches.

synopsis: Every actual example launches every required hazard and accepts one native choice without crash. Hazard presentation differs by emergency and equipment effects distinguish the medical-continuity examples. Large option rows fit ordinary physical text size. Family relevance remains uneven: first decisions in fire, tornado and flood share the same options across all examples, while continuity state varies more visibly.

failures.diagnosis: The matrix checks an accepted feedback element but does not assert changed committed balances/routes, subsequent available choices, person outcomes or refreshed scores.
failures.fix: Add deterministic receipt/action assertions and second consequential gates, supported spatial alternatives and no-supported-action cases; keep this matrix labeled smoke only.

failures.diagnosis: Relocation/cooling choices refer to previously arranged destinations generically. Feedback qualifies missing arrangements, but the row itself is not established as feasible for each family before selection.
failures.fix: Bind availability and labels to confirmed destination/transport state, or render an explicit preparation-needed option with its actual limited simulation effect.

failures.diagnosis: Legacy measurement-confirmation wording remains visible above fire feedback in this compiled build, despite the requested removal of that workflow.
failures.fix: Trace and remove remaining user-facing confirmation warning when valid captured geometry is accepted, preserving separate operability/exterior-suitability unknowns.

recommendations: Retain distinct hazard presentation and equipment status differences; they are visible value beyond simple title changes.
Do not count identical first decisions as proof of personalized Codex intelligence. No live Codex was invoked.
For family identity strengthen the test with the canonical selected family ID and committed household scope receipt. Launch arguments alone plus equipment text are incomplete isolation evidence.
Reviewer originals and matrix contact sheets remain protected; no unredacted matrix assets released.
retests: Every family second gate, alternative choices with fixed schedule, full endings/debrief/practice-score refresh, switching/reset and in-flight isolation.
Varied layouts/origins/blocked connectors, unsupported destination and no-route states; accessibility size and selected languages.
limitations: 18 smoke cells and 36 inspected captures do not establish complete causal coverage, native family-experience acceptance or independent review.
I provided design diagnoses; a fresh independent reviewer must judge fixes before claiming independent acceptance.
